subject: MAP: gated eval-kit access, single-use token cadence and destruction timeline
messages:
From: Sally Nguyen <sally@brightretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: trial-ops@brightretail.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP for trial — dataset access question

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team liked the latency numbers. We want to run a small closed evaluation (MAP) against a 2-week window of our edge purchases. To move forward we need: a) a short MAP showing milestones and dates, b) a way to pull a limited set of testcases (about ~1,200 utterances) and c) clear usage constraints (no retention beyond 30 days, no redistribution).

Can Redwood provide single-use tokens or ephemeral access keys tied to the MAP, and a simple acceptance checklist we can share with procurement?

Sally
Sally Nguyen
Head of Trials, BrightRetail
Sally.Nguyen@brightretail.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sally Nguyen <sally@brightretail.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: gated eval-kit access, single-use token cadence and destruction timeline

Hi Sally — appreciate the clear ask and glad the demo resonated.

Short answers up front: yes, we can provide single-use (timeboxed) tokens and we can bake the retention/destruction requirements into the MAP and token policy. Attached is a quick MAP-draft (MAP-draft-v1.pdf) and a token policy doc (token-policy.md) that lays out:
- how tokens are minted (can be single-use or TTL-bound)
- what endpoints they permit (download-only vs API inference)
- audit hooks and expiry enforcement

Proposed cadence for your scope (1,200 utterances):
1) Week 0 (Tue): Redwood shares gated artifact bundle (preview of 200 sample testcases).
2) Week 1: BrightRetail runs initial pass and shares quality sanity notes.
3) Week 2: Full 1,200 access window using single-use tokens (tokens expire after 72 hours).
4) Day 14+: Redwood confirms deletion of ephemeral copies and uploads destruction attestations.

If that looks OK I can turn this MAP into a signed playbook for procurement. Kimberly — can you confirm the attestation format we use for destruction? Karthik — can you confirm that the tokens can be limited to download-only (no inference) if they prefer?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf, token-policy.md

From: Sally Nguyen <sally@brightretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: trial-ops@brightretail.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: gated eval-kit access, single-use token cadence and destruction timeline

Thanks Naomi — this structure is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side (copied from our ops lead below):
- Single-use tokens are preferred for the download step; we do not want remote inference against our raw utterances.
- We need explicit proof-of-destruction artifacts that include a timestamped audit file and an auditor signature (internal ops OK).
- Can Redwood sign an NDA addendum that includes the 30-day retention and no-redistribution clause?

On timing: we can start the MAP on Aug 4 (internal calendar conflict otherwise). If you can shift the window to start Aug 4 → Aug 18 we’ll be able to land procurement in time.

On the token expiry: trial-ops asked whether 72 hours is adjustable to 48h for the second wave — they prefer shorter TTLs.

—Sally

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: gated eval-kit access, single-use token cadence and destruction timeline

Sally — thanks for the timing note, Aug 4 start is fine. Quick confirmations: 
- Tokens: we will issue download-only single-use tokens for wave 1 (48h TTL) and a second set for the full wave (48h TTL by request). Tokens are minted per-user and scoped to the artifact bundle. No inference endpoints will be enabled for those tokens.
- NDA addendum: attaching a short addendum clause in the MAP-draft (see updated v1) — we can execute via DocuSign.
- Deletion attestation: Kimberly confirms we use a timestamped JSONL audit with signer name + internal ops signature. We will place that attestation in the shared Drive folder and send the DocuSign confirmation link when the MAP is executed.

Attached: testcases-preview.zip (200 sample testcases) — this is gated; download requires the token we issue after the MAP is countersigned. Please confirm who on your team should receive the initial preview token (email list).

Next steps:
- You confirm the two users (or a short list) for preview token issuance.
- We update the MAP into a DocuSign-ready playbook and route to procurement.

Thanks — Naomi

Naomi Feldman
Sr. Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
attachments: testcases-preview.zip
